reviews.comment:
Lastima, que muchos pasan a reabastecer de combustible y descansar para continuar, los baños no son reparados, es una pena un lugar muy lindo que los dueños no inviertan para mejorar y que se pueda quedar más tiempo para tomar un café, mate o comer algo mientras descansas.

(Translated by Google)
It's a shame that many people stop to refuel and rest before continuing their journey. The bathrooms aren't repaired. It's a pity that such a nice place isn't being improved by the owners, so that people can stay longer, have a coffee, mate, or something to eat while they rest.
